strongest_bounded_proposition: Bornu was materially involved in slave raiding and trans-Saharan slave trading across the period leading into 1800.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not turn campaign/raid/trade intensity into numeric territorial prevalence inside Bornu.
territorial_practice_summary: Enslavement/slaveholding supported in broader Bornu context; internal prevalence not quantified.
external_network_summary: Bornu directly documented in slave raiding and trans-Saharan exchange.
temporal_scope_precision: Sources span sixteenth–nineteenth centuries and encompass 1800.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible packet only; non-English/non-digitized scholarship not exhaustively searched.
